svg.font-family: 'DejaVu Sans Mono', Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace
svg.aria-label: Flightdeck in a fullscreen terminal, with made-up sample data
svg.text: > add refresh-token rotation to the session service, with tests
I'll rotate the refresh token on every use, then cover it with tests.
Rotation is in place: each refresh issues a new token and revokes the old one,
and a reused token signs the whole session out. The new tests cover both paths.
